auth.description:
To Obtain a Client ID and Client Secret:

1. Go to https://developers.facebook.com/
2. Register for a Facebook Developer account.
3. Once login, click "Make a new app" button.
4. Select "Other" for use cases.
5. Choose "Business" as the type of app. 
6. Provide application details: custom name and associated email.
7. Once your application is created, you need to add a new "product".
8. Configure a new product of type "Facebook Login Settings".
9. Default settings should be fine, you only need to provide the Redirect URL in "Valid OAuth Redirect URIs" and your domain name in "Allowed Domains for the JavaScript SDK".
10. Finally, get your application ID and application secret from your app dashboard in Settings > Basic.

aiMetadata.description: Publishes a text status update to the feed of a Facebook Page the connected account manages, optionally attaching a link that Facebook will render as a preview card. Choose this for plain-text or link announcements; use the photo or video post actions for media uploads. Requires selecting a managed page (which supplies the page-scoped access token) and a message; not idempotent, as each call publishes a separate post.

create_photo_post.name: create_photo_post
create_photo_post.description: Create a photo on a Facebook Page you manage

photo.description: A URL we can access for the photo

aiMetadata.description: Publishes a photo post to a Facebook Page the connected account manages by uploading an image from a publicly reachable URL, with an optional caption. Choose this when the post is an image rather than plain text or video. Requires a managed page and a photo URL that Facebook can fetch; not idempotent, as each call creates a new photo post.

create_video_post.name: create_video_post
create_video_post.description: Create a video on a Facebook Page you manage

video.description: A URL we can access for the video (Limit: 1GB or 20 minutes)

aiMetadata.description: Publishes a video post to a Facebook Page the connected account manages by uploading a video from a publicly reachable URL, with an optional title and description. Choose this for video content rather than text or photo posts. Requires a managed page and a video URL Facebook can fetch (limit 1GB or 20 minutes); not idempotent, as each call uploads a new video.

nl.Manage your Facebook pages to grow your: Beheer uw Facebook-pagina's om uw bedrijf te laten groeien
nl.\nTo Obtain a Client ID and Client Secre:
Om een Client ID en Client Secret:
. Ga naar https://developers.facebook. om/
2. Registreer voor een Facebook Developer account.
3. Eenmaal ingelogd, klik op de knop "Maak een nieuwe app".
4. Selecteer "Andere" voor gebruik gevallen.
5. Kies "Business" als het type app. 
6. Geef de applicatie details: aangepaste naam en bijbehorende e-mail.
7. Zodra uw applicatie is aangemaakt, moet u een nieuw "product" toevoegen.
8. Configureer een nieuw product van het type "Facebook Login Settings".
9. Standaard instellingen zijn prima, u hoeft alleen de Redirect URL in "Geldige OAuth Redirect URI" en uw domeinnaam in "Toegestane Domains voor de JavaScript SDK" in te geven.
10. Haal ten slotte uw applicatie ID en applicatie geheim van uw app dashboard in Instellingen > Basic.

de.Manage your Facebook pages to grow your: Verwalten Sie Ihre Facebook-Seiten, um Ihr Geschäft zu wachsen
de.\nTo Obtain a Client ID and Client Secre:
um eine Client-ID und Client-Geheimnis zu erhalten:
. Gehe zu https://developers.facebook. om/
2. Registrieren Sie sich für ein Facebook-Entwickler-Konto.
3. Sobald Sie sich einloggen, klicken Sie auf "Neue App erstellen".
4. Wählen Sie "Andere" für Anwendungsfälle.
5. Wählen Sie "Business" als Art der App aus. 
6. Geben Sie Anwendungsdetails an: benutzerdefinierter Name und zugeordnete E-Mail.
7. Sobald Ihre Anwendung erstellt wurde, müssen Sie ein neues "Produkt" hinzufügen.
8. Konfigurieren Sie ein neues Produkt vom Typ "Facebook-Login-Einstellungen".
9. Standardeinstellungen sollten in Ordnung sein, Sie müssen nur die Redirect URL in "Valid OAuth Redirect URIs" und Ihren Domainnamen in "Allowed Domains for the JavaScript SDK" angeben.
10. Schließlich erhalten Sie Ihre Anwendungs-ID und Anwendung unter Einstellungen > Basic.

pt.Manage your Facebook pages to grow your: Gerencie suas páginas do Facebook para expandir seus negócios
pt.\nTo Obtain a Client ID and Client Secre:
Para obter um ID de cliente e o segredo de cliente:
. Vá para https://developers.facebook. O/
2. Registre-se para uma conta de desenvolvedor do Facebook.
3. Uma vez login, clique no botão "Criar um novo aplicativo".
4. Selecione "Outros" para casos de uso.
5. Escolha "Negócios" como o tipo de aplicativo. 
6. Forneça detalhes do aplicativo: nome personalizado e e-mail associado.
7. Uma vez que sua aplicação é criada, você precisa adicionar um novo "produto".
8. Configure um novo produto do tipo "Configurações do Login do Facebook".
9. As configurações padrão devem estar corretas, você só precisa fornecer a URL de redirecionamento em "URLs válidas de redirecionamento OAuth" e seu nome de domínio em "Domínios permitidos para o JavaScript SDK".
10. Finalmente, obtenha o ID e o segredo do aplicativo no painel do seu aplicativo em Configurações > Basic.
